PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (Weeks 10-14)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "gradual return to full-body strength and core stability without impact"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Acclimate A - Core + Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Acclimate B - Lower + Core":

          walking 5m

          reverse_lunge 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds

          pallof_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
